senses.gloss: (√בק, v. preced.; cmp. בצא, a. בין; v. בקר, בקש &c.) to search, investigate, examine, find out. Part. בָּקֵי.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:3">Targ. Prov. XVII, 3</cite> <he>צרפא בקי</he> Bxt. (ed. <cite ref="N01193"><he>נקי</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 24:12">Ib. XXIV, 12</cite> <he>בָּאקֵי</he> Ms. (Bxt. a. oth. <cite ref="B01072"><he>בצי</he></cite>; corrupt. <cite ref="B00014"><he>באהי</he></cite>; h. text <he>יבין</he>).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:5">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>בְּקִי באבוך וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 964:14">Yalk. Prov. 964</cite> <he>בַּקְרִי</he>) find out what thy father is doing now.
<cite ref="Pesachim 3b:13">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>בקי מאי דיניה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בדוק</he>) find out his ways and manners.
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:11">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ליבקי וכ׳</he> let one search for the body of one who died on a Sabbath.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:2:1">Koh. R. to XI, 2</cite> (read:) <he>עד דאינון בקיין תרין חיואן וכ׳</he> (strike out <he>אזלון בעיין … ונפקין</he>) while they were searching (for the grave), two serpents of fire &c.
